tree.heading: In general
tree.text: After receiving a notification for purposes of section 300ff–132 or 300ff–133(d)(2) of this title, a designated officer of emergency response employees shall, to the extent practicable, immediately notify each of such employees who—

children.text: responded to the emergency involved; and
as indicated by guidelines developed by the Secretary, may have been exposed to an infectious disease.

tree.heading: Certain contents of notification to employee
tree.text: A notification under this subsection to an emergency response employee shall inform the employee of—

children.text: the fact that the employee may have been exposed to an infectious disease and the name of the disease involved;
any action by the employee that, as indicated by guidelines developed by the Secretary, is medically appropriate; and
if medically appropriate under such criteria, the date of such emergency.

tree.heading: Responses other than notification of exposure
tree.text: After receiving a response under paragraph (3) or (4) of subsection (d) of section 300ff–133 of this title, or a response under subsection (g)(1) of such section, the designated officer for the employee shall, to the extent practicable, immediately inform the employee of the response.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective as if enacted on Sept. 30, 2009, see section 2(a)(3)(B) of Pub. L. 111–87, set out as an Effective Date of 2009 Amendment; Revival of Section note under section 300ff–11 of this title.
